description.value: Blanshard St. Winery is a locally owned, family-operated craft winery that has been producing wines in Victoria since 1996, making it the longest-running winery in the city under its original owners. Spread across a 4,000 sq ft facility with state-of-the-art bottling equipment, it offers an extensive lineup spanning premium reds and whites, dessert wines, wine coolers, and ciders sourced from vineyards around the world. A touring cyclist interested in BC's craft beverage scene could visit to browse or purchase bottles, with wedding and custom-label wine services also available.
